_about: Bernard P. Grenfell (1869-1926) and Arthur S. Hunt (1871-1934), the Oxford papyrologists who dug Oxyrhynchus: all seventeen parts of The Oxyrhynchus Papyri (1898-1927; Parts VII-IX and XVII edited by Hunt alone, Part XVI with H. I. Bell), with Greek Papyri Series II (New Classical Fragments, 1897), Revenue Laws of Ptolemy Philadelphus (1896), Fayum Towns (1900), the Amherst Papyri (1900-01), Tebtunis Papyri I-II (1902, 1907; Part II survives only in the 1970 photographic reprint), the Cairo Greek Papyri catalogue (1903), Hibeh Papyri I (1906), Logia Iesou (1897) and New Sayings of Jesus (1904). Greek-heavy: Greek text with English translation and notes; kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling, and queued for a later Greek re-OCR pass. Tebtunis III (1933, 1938) left out as post-1929; the 1909 Oxford text Hellenica Oxyrhynchia has no English. Classical scholarship (lane B, round dg). Raw IA OCR. No uids minted.
_author: Bernard Pyne Grenfell (1869-1926) and Arthur Surridge Hunt (1871-1934)
